author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 8; ensure at least four current turns classified as order_logistics across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer ordered a desk lamp but the package shows delivered while they never received it.

messages.content: My tracking says my lamp was delivered yesterday but I never got it. What can I do?
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me check the delivery details for you. Can you confirm your order number?
Sure, it's #48291. The carrier photo shows a doorstep but I live in an apartment building.
Thank you. I see the carrier marked it as left at the front desk. Let me open an investigation with them.

variants.text: Actually, forget the lamp. I want to return the headphones I bought last week instead.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Okay, please go ahead with the investigation. Also, how long does that usually take?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Wait, I also ordered a mouse pad in the same shipment. Was that in the same box?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer asks about a coffee maker's water filter replacement.

messages.content: Hi, I bought your drip coffee maker model CM-200 about four months ago.
Great, how can I help you with your CM-200 today?
The manual mentions a charcoal water filter that should be swapped every two months. I never got any in the box.
The CM-200 ships with one filter pre-installed. Replacement filters are sold separately under SKU CF-10.

variants.text: Thanks, that answers it. By the way, is it supposed to make that gurgling noise when brewing?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Alright, I'll order the CF-10. Can you also tell me if my current order #7712 has shipped yet?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Hmm, actually I think I'm confusing this with my old machine. Never mind, thanks anyway.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer's subscription order for pet food was charged twice.

messages.content: I see two charges on my card for my monthly cat food subscription this month.
I apologize for that. Let me pull up your subscription account to check for duplicate billing.
It's under my email jane.k@mail.com. Both charges are for $34.99, one on the 2nd and one on the 5th.
I can see the duplicate. The second charge was triggered by a system error when you updated your payment method.

variants.text: Please refund the second charge. And will this mess up my next delivery date?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: I see. Can you just cancel the whole subscription then? I'll go back to buying in store.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: That's frustrating. I want to speak to a supervisor about this billing mistake.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer asks about a smartwatch's compatibility with their phone.

messages.content: Does your FitPro 3 watch work with a Samsung Galaxy A54?
Yes, the FitPro 3 is compatible with Android 10 and above, so the A54 works fine.
Great. And can I receive WhatsApp notifications on it, or just calls?
You can receive WhatsApp, SMS, and call notifications. You just need to grant notification access in the app.

variants.text: Perfect, that's all I needed. Have a nice day!
variants.label: general

variants.text: One more thing — my order for the FitPro 3 was supposed to arrive Tuesday but it's Thursday now. Where is it?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, I'm reconsidering. Does the older FitPro 2 have the same WhatsApp support? Maybe I should get that one.
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer's delivery address was mistyped and package is now stuck.

messages.content: I think I typed my zip code wrong on my last order. It says out for delivery but I'm worried.
Let me check. What's the order number and the zip code you entered?
Order #9034, and I put 90210 but I actually live in 90211. It's already out for delivery though.
I see that. Since it's already with the courier, I'll flag it for a delivery intercept right away.

variants.text: Please do that. Also, I need to update my saved address for future orders — how do I do that?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, you know what, just let it go to the wrong address. I'll deal with it. Cancel the intercept.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Hold on, I also can't log into my account to check anything. It keeps saying wrong password.
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer bought a yoga mat that arrived with a tear.

messages.content: My yoga mat arrived today and there's a two-inch tear along the edge.
Oh no, I'm sorry about that. Was it in the original packaging when you opened it?
Yes, the box was sealed and undamaged. It must have been a manufacturing defect.
Understood. Since it's defective, we can offer a replacement or a full refund including shipping.

variants.text: I'll take the replacement. But wait, will I need to send the torn one back first?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, I'd rather just get my money back. Please process the refund.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Thanks. Also, is there a way to talk to a real person about this? The chat bot has been fine but I want a human.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer asks about warranty coverage on a blender.

messages.content: My blender's motor stopped working after about a year. Is that covered under warranty?
Our blenders carry a 2-year warranty. Do you have your purchase receipt or order number handy?
I bought it from your site, order #5510. It was in January of last year.
Perfect, that order is within the warranty window. I can set up a repair or replacement for you.

variants.text: Great, let's do the replacement. Oh, and do you know if the new one comes with a different blade design?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, I just realized I bought this from a different store, not your site. Sorry for the confusion.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Before we do that — my order history shows two blenders. I want to make sure we're talking about the right one.
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer's winter jacket order is delayed due to weather.

messages.content: I ordered a winter jacket on the 10th and it was supposed to arrive by the 18th. It's the 20th now.
Let me look into that. Can I have your order number?
It's #6621. The tracking hasn't updated in four days, it just says 'in transit'.
I see the carrier has a weather delay notice for your region. The package is safe, just held up.

variants.text: Okay, that's reassuring. How much longer do you think the delay will be?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: I can't wait any longer — I leave for my trip Friday. Can you cancel and refund this?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Thanks for checking. By the way, do you carry this jacket in a tall size? I might order another one.
variants.label: product_technical
